async def simulate(*, sim, tasks, vars):
    result = await sim.run(tasks['plastic'])
    await sim.record('plastic_displacement', result["artifacts"]['displacement'])
    await sim.record('plastic_reaction', result["artifacts"]['reaction'])
    await sim.record('plastic_stress', result["artifacts"]['stress'])
    await sim.record('plastic_stressField', result["artifacts"]['stressField'])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    sim.release(result["state"])
    result = await sim.run(tasks['contact'])
    await sim.record('contact_displacement', result["artifacts"]['displacement'])
    await sim.record('contact_reaction', result["artifacts"]['reaction'])
    await sim.record('contact_stress', result["artifacts"]['stress'])
    await sim.record('contact_stressField', result["artifacts"]['stressField'])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    sim.release(result["state"])
    result = await sim.run(tasks['laminate'])
    await sim.record('laminate_displacement', result["artifacts"]['displacement'])
    await sim.record('laminate_reaction', result["artifacts"]['reaction'])
    await sim.record('laminate_stress', result["artifacts"]['stress'])
    await sim.record('laminate_stressField', result["artifacts"]['stressField'])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    sim.release(result["state"])
